en: Color postcard showing a wooden mountain lodge surrounded by tall evergreens and patches of late snow. The reverse has Romanian layout text "CARTE POSTALA," a 40 BANI Romanian stamp, a blue postmark reading "SINAIA," and a purple circular cancel. Addressed in blue ink to Câmpina, Prahova, with a short handwritten message at left. The caption at bottom left reads "CABANA BOLOBOCI."
